headings: ## Allowlist: files that may leave this project

preserved_rules: A transition records observed readiness, not an approval.
Private content never enters a build-lane output or a cross-host pack.
Everything not on this list stays here.
An allowlist supplies no new reading, writing or redistribution authority.
A method supplies techniques and checks; it does not grant authority or override adopted decisions.

headings: ## 4. What this position does not decide

preserved_rules: Two active baselines are never allowed.

each affected output is refreshed or marked stale.

formats: Status values: OPEN, HOLD (blocks a gate), CLOSED (with the file 10 entry that closed it), DROPPED (with the reason).

preserved_rules: An item closes only when its evidence is read, not when someone restates the claim.

the scribe maps it at merge.

formats: Format: DD-MM-YYYY h:mm AM/PM | type | detail | source
Types: meeting, claim, evidence, decision, gate, terms, deadline, revision.

preserved_rules: Append only. Never rewrite or delete an entry; add a superseding entry instead.
A decision is logged only after it is made, never in advance.
A gate entry records Proceed, Hold or Walk, the reason, and the work that may continue.

authorized_parser_fixture_revision.change: Generalize the synthetic possessive name to Owner in the valid YAML input and its expected parsed description. Retain the doubled YAML apostrophe, embedded colon, single parsed apostrophe and exact assertion.

routing.pass_rule: Pass rule for a manual run: every positive row loads the expected skills in at least 2 of 3 fresh sessions; every negative row shows no project routing, no project facts and no build-lane tools/writes in 3 of 3; router-load is a separate observation and may occur only for scope decline.
routing.spending_policy: No paid batch runs or paid tests without separate explicit scope and spending authority.
routing.normalization: Only the dated personal spending decision is replaced by an explicit spending-authority rule. Routing cases, expected behaviors, positive 2-of-3 threshold and negative 3-of-3 threshold are retained.

limits: Static compatibility checks, not successful model routing, native loading, authority grants or host execution evidence.
